description: Multi-step onboarding coach-mark overlay with a dark popover anchored to a target element, used for the admin first-run tour.

steps.description: Array of step objects with shape { step, anchorId, title, body }

currentStep.description: Index of the currently displayed step (1-based)

totalSteps.description: Total number of steps in the tour

onNext.description: Callback when the Next button is pressed

onBack.description: Callback when the Back button is pressed

onSkip.description: Callback when the Skip link is tapped

onComplete.description: Callback when the final step's Next is pressed

anatomy: cut-out (8px padding around anchored element, radius small 8)
footer-row (step-dots 6x6 radius full + back tertiary + next primary + skip link label-small)

sizes.name: default
sizes.note: footer-row height; popover height is content-driven
